frontend.title: Welcome to my experience as a frontend developer
frontend.description: Here you'll find some of the things I can do and have learned from my various front-end development skills.

html.title: HTML
skills: Semantic layout: I use HTML5 tags like <header>, <nav>, <main>, <section> and <footer> to create accessible web structures optimized for Search Engine Optimization (SEO).
Professional styling: I have used CSS3, sass and the framework Bootstrap to create modern, responsive and attractive interfaces.

angular.title: Angular
angular.subtitle: Tools and dependencies used:
angular.description: I have a medium-high experience using angular for a few years (2021 - present), I have had the opportunity to build applications from scratch and maintain them. With different technologies and dependencies that help me provide tailored solutions for the different clients and companies I've worked for.
skills: Application development: I have experience building single-page applications and microservices using Angular, I have had the opportunity to use the component system (NgModule and Standalone), services and routing.
Data linking and directives: Efficient use of bidirectional data links, structural directives (*ngIf, *ngFor) and custom directives to create dynamic and reusable interfaces.
APIs and services: Integration of HTTP services to use APIs REST, using observables and state management with RxJS.

aspnet.title: ASP.NET
aspnet.subtitle: Tools and dependencies used:
aspnet.description: I have a high experience in ASP.NET creating web applications since 2017, Using different technologies and dependencies that make my job easier to offer high-quality applications. I have had a lot of challenges throughout my professional career.
skills: Development with ASP.NET C# and Visual Basic: Building modern web applications using ASP.NET with C# and Visual Basic, applying the MVC pattern to separate responsibilities and facilitate maintenance.
WebServer: WebServer implementation, including controllers, routes, responses in JSON and XML format, and input validations.
Authentication and authorization: Identity integration to manage users, roles and access policies in secure applications.
Deployment and configuration: Publishing applications to IIS, using files, dependency injection and configuration environment.
Template implementation: Integration of templates to facilitate the use of Bootstrap framework design and management.

backend.title: Welcome to my experience as a backend developer
backend.description: Here you'll find some of the things I can do and have learned from my various back-end development skills.

javascript.title: JavaScript
javascript.subtitle: Tools and dependencies used:
javascript.description: I have extensive experience in this language developing functions and methods since 2022. I have learned different things throughout my professional career, however, I know that I still have much more to learn and perfect.
skills: Development of dynamic web applications: Experience developing interactive applications using pure JavaScript (vanilla JS), manipulating the DOM directly to create reusable and functional components.
Event-oriented programming: Using native browser events to handle user interactions, forms, validations and dynamic navigation without reloading the page.
APIs: Integration with APIs REST using fetch and XMLHttpRequest, Promise handling and JSON response processing to update the UI in real time.
Modularization and good practices: Code organization with pure functions, ES6 modules (import/export), and separation of logic to improve code maintainability.

python.title: JavaScript
python.subtitle: Tools and dependencies used:
python.description: I have little experience in pyton, however, I have been able to learn and develop different methods for solving different challenges. I would like to be able to learn more things such as managing data volumes in a more perfect way and learning how to manipulate them in different ways.
skills: Script development and automation: Experience writing scripts in python to automate tasks, process files, transform data and run scheduled tasks.

Consuming APIs and handling HTTP requests: Integration with external services through the requests library, handling of GET/POST/UPDATE/DELETE/PATCH requests, authentications, and processing of responses in JSON format using JWT or XML.
Good practices and readability: Application of principles such as PEP8, use of efficient data structures, and modular programming oriented toward functions and classes to improve code clarity.

csharp.title: C#
csharp.subtitle: Tools and dependencies used:
csharp.description: I have extensive experience developing with C# and have been creating applications since 2014, having been self-taught since I graduated from high school. I've faced challenges that I've overcome, albeit with some difficulties, but the university where I developed this language helped me learn a lot.
skills: Web application development: Experience building enterprise web applications using C# and ASP.NET (Web Forms and MVC) as web services, structuring projects with logical separation between presentation, business logic and data access.
Lifecycle management and server controls: Efficient use of the page lifecycle ASP.NET, as well as server controls, events and client and server-side validations to create interactive interfaces.
Database integration: Connecting and manipulating data using ADO.NET and Entity Framework, making inquiries SQL, stored procedures and operations CRUD in relational environments such as SQL Server.
Services and communication between layers: Implementation of web services (ASMX or WCF), session management, cookies, and layered architecture to ensure system modularity and maintainability.
